collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A parent assumes their teenage twins will both learn fishing, but one wants to study plants instead.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a parent, assumes their teenage twins will both learn fishing, but one wants to fish and the other wants to study plants with the healer.

choices.label: Ask Each Twin Separately What They Want.
Let Them Try Each Other's Work for a Week.
Ask the Healer and a Fisher to Talk with Them.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The parent struggles with the change but keeps listening.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The quieter twin speaks more freely when alone.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Both twins want something slightly different from what they first said.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Each twin respects the other's choice more afterward.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The twins learn what each path truly involves.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The healer's talk makes plants sound so exciting that the fishing twin wavers.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: Each twin thrives in their own work, and they share stories each evening.

c2__fx.name: Outcome C2
c2__fx.text: Both twins complain about the other's work, and laugh about it later.
